# audio

PipeWire audio: the server, its ALSA/JACK/Pulse front ends and WirePlumber.

Volume keys go through `osd-volume` ([swayosd](swayosd.md)); media keys use playerctl. `rtkit` gives PipeWire realtime scheduling (it fixes the "RTKit error" in its log).

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`audio/packages`): `pipewire`, `pipewire-alsa`, `pipewire-jack`, `pipewire-pulse`, `wireplumber`, `gst-plugin-pipewire`, `libpulse`, `rtkit` (realtime scheduling for PipeWire/WirePlumber (fixes "RTKit error")), `sox`, `playerctl` (media keys)
